en-US.author: Orchestrator.inc
en-US.description: Run and supervise teams of coding agents from planning to merge.
en-US.longDescription:
Agent Orchestrator lets you plan, run, and supervise coding agents from one place. Give every coding task its own agent, workspace, and feedback loop, and delegate larger outcomes to a project-aware orchestrator.
Each project gets a main agent that runs the fleet and spawns workers into separate Git worktrees, with a kanban board showing each session's branch, PR, and CI state. Failed CI checks and review comments are routed back to the agent that owns the branch. It supports around 25 agent harnesses including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Aider, and Goose, plus a mobile companion app.

- A machine's host key, so a device with its account token cannot act as it by @illegalcall in #7495

zh-CN.description: 从规划到合并，运行并监督编码智能体团队。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Agent Orchestrator 让你在一个地方规划、运行并监督编码智能体。为每个编码任务配备专属的智能体、工作区和反馈回路，并把更大的目标交给具备项目意识的编排者来分解执行。
每个项目由一个主智能体统领全局，并将工作智能体派生到独立的 Git worktree 中，看板会显示每个会话的分支、PR 和 CI 状态。失败的 CI 检查和审查意见会被路由回拥有该分支的智能体。它支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode、Aider、Goose 等约 25 种智能体工具，并配有手机端伴侣应用。
